org.portico.container

Class DaemonManager

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.portico.container.DaemonManager

  • public class DaemonManager
extends Object
    This class manages a set of IDaemon implementations on behalf of a Container. It aggregates together all the configured Daemon instances and makes it easy to manage their lifecycle as one.

    • Method Detail

      • registerDaemon

        public void registerDaemon(IDaemon daemon)
        Add a new IDaemon to the group that is managed by this class.

      • removeDaemon

        public IDaemon removeDaemon(String daemonName)
        This method will find and remove the IDaemon of the given name from the group managed by this class. If there is no Daemon by that name, null will be returned. Note that this method will NOT stop the Daemon before removing it. It is up to you to stop the Daemon before removing it.

      • containsDaemon

        public boolean containsDaemon(String daemonName)
        Returns true if there is a IDaemon of the given name registered with this manager, false otherwise.

      • getAllDaemons

        public Collection<IDaemon> getAllDaemons()
        This will return an unmodifiable Set of all the contained IDaemons. If there are no registered Daemons, an empty set will be returned.

      • size

        public int size()

      • startDaemons

        public void startDaemons()
        This method will attempt to start all the IDaemons registered with the manager. If a given Daemon fails to configure or start, the error will be logged, but the manager will keep on going, attempting to start the other Daemons.

        NOTE: Any IDaemon that fails to start will be removed.

        NOTE: This method will only attempt to start daemons that are not active (those that return false from IDaemon.isActive()).

      • stopDaemons

        public void stopDaemons()
        This method will shutdown each of the contained IDaemon. If a Daemon fails to shutdown (throws an exception), this information will be logged, but the manager will move on to the next Daemon and attempt to shut it down.

      • notifyLrcCreated

        public void notifyLrcCreated(LRC lrc)
        Notify all the registered IDaemons that a new LRC has started up via the IDaemon.lrcCreated(LRC) method.

      • notifyLrcDestroyed

        public void notifyLrcDestroyed(LRC lrc)
        Notify all the registered IDaemons that a previously existing LRC is about to be destroyed via the IDaemon.lrcDestroyed(LRC) method.
